name: CapCut
bestFor: Editing Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts on your phone or computer
about: CapCut is a free video editor for phones, computers and the web. It is the most popular choice for short videos because it is easy and full of trending effects, templates and music.
Its AI features add auto captions, remove backgrounds, clean up audio and turn long videos into short clips.
useCases: Remove a video background without a green screen
features: Text to speech and voice effects

howToUse.title: Install CapCut
howToUse.text: Download the app on your phone or computer, or use the web version.

howToUse.title: Start a new project
howToUse.text: Tap New project and add your clips and photos.

howToUse.title: Cut and arrange
howToUse.text: Trim the start and end of each clip and drag them into order.

howToUse.title: Add captions
howToUse.text: Open Text > Auto captions, pick the language, and fix any wrong words.

howToUse.title: Add music and export
howToUse.text: Add sound, then export in 1080p and the right size, such as 9:16 for Reels.

tips: Use templates to copy a trending style in minutes.
Check captions carefully: names and Urdu words are often misheard.
Use only music you have the rights to if you post for a business.
limitations: Some effects and AI tools need CapCut Pro.
Read the terms: CapCut's licence on uploaded content has worried some creators.
freePlanDetails: Usually no watermark on your own footage.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.

name: Descript
shortDescription: Edit video and podcasts by editing the text transcript.
bestFor: Editing talking videos and podcasts as easily as editing a document
about: Descript turns your video or audio into a transcript. To cut something, you delete the words from the text and Descript cuts the video for you.
It also removes filler words like "um", improves audio quality, fixes eye contact and can record your screen.
useCases: Cut short clips from long videos
features: Studio Sound to clean up audio
AI voice to fix a word you said wrong

howToUse.title: Sign up and install
howToUse.text: Create an account at descript.com and use the web or desktop app.

howToUse.title: Import your video
howToUse.text: Start a project and drag in your video or audio file. Descript writes the transcript.

howToUse.title: Edit the text
howToUse.text: Delete words and sentences in the transcript to cut them from the video.

howToUse.title: Clean up
howToUse.text: Remove filler words and turn on Studio Sound for better audio.

howToUse.title: Export
howToUse.text: Export the video or publish a link.

tips: Fix transcript mistakes first so search and captions are correct.
Use the AI assistant to suggest short clips for social media.
limitations: Transcription works best for English and some other major languages.
The free plan has a small amount of media time per month.
freePlanDetails: 60 media minutes per month and some free AI credits.

name: OpusClip
shortDescription: Turns long videos into short viral clips automatically.
bestFor: Turning long YouTube videos and podcasts into many Shorts and Reels
about: OpusClip watches your long video, finds the best moments and turns them into short vertical clips with captions. Each clip gets a "virality score" guess.
It saves podcasters and YouTubers hours of manual cutting.
useCases: Turn a webinar into social clips
features: Reframes to vertical and follows the speaker

howToUse.title: Add your video
howToUse.text: Paste a YouTube link or upload a file.

howToUse.title: Choose settings
howToUse.text: Pick clip length, caption style and which part of the video to use.

howToUse.title: Review the clips
howToUse.text: Watch the suggested clips and edit the start, end and captions.

howToUse.title: Export or schedule
howToUse.text: Download the clips or post them directly.

tips: Clear speech and good audio give better clip choices.
Don't trust the virality score too much. Watch each clip yourself.
limitations: Free clips have a watermark and expire after a few days.
Works best with talking videos, not music or gameplay.
freePlanDetails: 60 credits per month, with a watermark.
pricingNote: US prices. One credit is about one minute of video processed.

name: VEED
shortDescription: Online video editor with subtitles, translation and AI tools.
bestFor: Quick online editing, subtitles and translations without installing anything
about: VEED is a video editor that works in your browser. It is quick for simple edits and especially good at subtitles: it can transcribe, translate and style captions in many languages.
It also has a screen recorder, a teleprompter and AI avatars.
useCases: Resize a video for different platforms

howToUse.title: Open VEED
howToUse.text: Go to veed.io and create an account.

howToUse.title: Upload your video
howToUse.text: Upload a file or paste a link.

howToUse.title: Add subtitles
howToUse.text: Click Subtitles > Auto subtitle, choose the language, and fix any mistakes.

howToUse.title: Edit and export
howToUse.text: Trim, add text and music, then export.

tips: Translate subtitles to reach viewers in other languages.
Upload in good quality: exports can't be better than the original.
limitations: Big files can be slow to upload on a weak internet connection.
freePlanDetails: Free editing with a watermark on exports.
pricingNote: US prices. The Lite prices we found ranged from $12 to $24 per month, so check the website.
